graph_metadata.networkx_representation: MultiDiGraph (Multi: a pair may carry edges of several different types; Directed: chaining is directional, co_context/shared_root_cause are symmetric but stored once and treated as undirected via to_undirected() for connectivity checks)
graph_metadata.pyg_directionality_plan: chaining -> single (source,target) edge_index entry; co_context / shared_root_cause -> expanded to both (source,target) and (target,source) entries at PyG conversion time (Phase 4, not yet implemented)
